title: V9 ImplementationRunner declared in orchestrator + select_v9_implementation_runner factory exists, but CLI never installs it and orchestrator never invokes .run() — CONVERGED plans never produce implementation_requested events; aria-implementer subprocess never spawns; real PR creation pipeline is structurally broken
raised_by: ARIA-V10.5 F-026 validation endurance (v10-5-f-026-validation-20260521-194905) cycle 3 — first CONVERGED cycle reached (verdict=converged, branch=terminal_state=CONVERGED, reasons=cross_review_convergence_gates_passed at 21:24:46), but worker_scheduler iterated idle indefinitely and 0 implementation_requested events emitted. F-024+F-025+F-026 trinity validation surfaced the gap as soon as a cycle actually converged.
resolved_by: ARIA-V10.5 Phase 7 (Tier-1 V9ImplementationRunner CLI factory wire + orchestrator post-CONVERGED invocation)

what_is_missing.missing_piece_1_cli_wire: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/cli.py:3620-3643 — the run_autonomy_orchestrator(...) call passes memory_hook=select_memory_hook(profile=profile) and cost_telemetry_hook=select_cost_telemetry_hook(profile=profile) but does NOT pass v9_implementation_runner=select_v9_implementation_runner(profile=profile). Result: orchestrator always uses NoOp default regardless of operator profile.
what_is_missing.missing_piece_2_orchestrator_invocation: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/autonomy_orchestrator.py — between line 1217 (memory_hook_recorded transition) and line 1253 (specialist_review_started transition) the v9_implementation_runner.run(...) call is missing. Result: even if the right runner is plumbed, .run() is never invoked.
what_is_missing.downstream_consequence: CONVERGED → memory_hook_recorded → (V9 phase SHOULD fire here) → specialist_review → worker_drainer → review → auto_merge. With V9 phase skipped: kernel state machine never receives implementation_requested event; aria-implementer subprocess never spawns; no real PR is created. worker_drainer processes the (empty) worker queue and reports status=idle indefinitely.

empirical_proof_of_gap.interpretation: Trinity (F-024+F-025+F-026) successfully delivered the kernel-correct CONVERGED outcome; the downstream pipeline that should consume that outcome is structurally absent.

structural_root_cause.incomplete_wiring: The V3.1-B implementation phase plan landed the runner Protocol + three concrete variants + the factory function + the orchestrator parameter declaration + the orchestrator default fallback to NoOp. The two final wiring statements — (1) CLI installs the factory's return value as the kwarg, (2) orchestrator invokes the runner between MemoryHook and specialist_review — were left as the operator-facing 'last mile'. Because the runner is plumbed but unwired, the system runs CONVERGED→specialist_review skipping the V9 phase silently. No test caught it because no integration test exercised an actual CONVERGED cycle end-to-end against the orchestrator surface.
structural_root_cause.lesson: A Protocol-typed dependency MUST have both an injection seam AND a call site. Declaring the dependency without invoking it produces dead infrastructure that looks complete to readers and to factory-style tests, but produces zero runtime effect. The F-024/F-025/F-026 trinity made the gap visible because before the trinity, no cycle reached CONVERGED in production to exercise the missing wiring.
structural_root_cause.tier_1_anchor: Closes the V3.1-B implementation-phase wiring per the docstring contract in cycle_phases/implementer.py:1-32: 'V9 closes the value gap CONVERGED plans never become real code'.

tier_1_architectural_fix.scope: (a) CLI: pass v9_implementation_runner=select_v9_implementation_runner(profile=profile) to run_autonomy_orchestrator analogous to existing memory_hook + cost_telemetry_hook factory wires. (b) Orchestrator: invoke v9_implementation_runner.run(...) between memory_hook_recorded and specialist_review_started transitions; emit v9_implementation_phase_started + v9_implementation_phase_resolved governance phase transitions; store result in cycle_summary['v9_implementation'].

aria-kernel/aria_kernel/autonomy_orchestrator.py (post-MemoryHook block: AutonomyStateReducer.transition v9_implementation_phase_started → v9_implementation_runner.run(...) → AutonomyStateReducer.transition v9_implementation_phase_resolved)

aria-kernel/tests/invariants/v10/test_phase_v10_5_phase_7_v9_runner_wired.py (5 Tier-3 invariants — CLI factory wire, orchestrator call site exists, call site phase ordering, profile dispatch correctness, runtime: NoOp returns refused signal)
tier_1_architectural_fix.tier_rationale: Tier-1 (make impossible): once CLI installs the factory + orchestrator invokes the runner, the V9 implementation phase becomes structurally part of the cycle. NoOp variant preserves V8 behavior for non-autonomous profiles (returns IMPLEMENTATION_REQUEST_REFUSED with specialist_review_signal=review_converged_plan), so existing semantics are preserved by default. Autonomous profile receives the production AutonomousV9ImplementationRunner which actually mints aria-implementer subprocess. Tier-3 detectable: 5 invariants pin the CLI wire, the orchestrator call site presence, the call-site phase ordering (between memory_hook and specialist_review), the profile-derived variant selection, and the runtime contract (NoOp returns IMPLEMENTATION_REQUEST_REFUSED so V8 behavior is preserved when injection is absent).

expected_impact_on_endurance.before_fix: Every CONVERGED cycle (e.g. cycle 3 of v10-5-f-026-validation) terminates the cycle without spawning aria-implementer. worker_scheduler iterates idle. No implementation_requested events. No real PRs. The V10.5 trinity validates the kernel-side of convergence, but the value delivery (CONVERGED → real PR) is unreachable.
expected_impact_on_endurance.after_fix: CONVERGED cycles with autonomous profile dispatch v9_implementation_runner.run() which mints the aria-implementer subprocess via issue_implementation_envelope, polls for IMPLEMENTATION_MERGED / IMPLEMENTATION_REJECTED outcome, and emits the corresponding plan_convergence events. worker_scheduler now has actual implementation work to process. The full V10.5 vision (autonomous CONVERGED → real PR) becomes structurally reachable.
